metadata.description: Google search tools for AI agents (live results, indexing, Search Console, site audits), from Find Untapped Growth.

plugins.name: untapped-resume
plugins.description: Build a source-backed resume, portfolio and LinkedIn kit for one job from local evidence. Free. Cannot post to LinkedIn; paste + upload takes about 2 minutes. Does not guarantee interviews.

plugins.name: untapped-serp
plugins.description: Live Google results and search volume for your agent, through your own DataForSEO account, with a daily spend cap.

plugins.name: untapped-index-watch
plugins.description: Checks every sitemap URL against Search Console's URL Inspection, says what each problem usually means and what to do, and shows what changed since the last check. Free.

plugins.name: untapped-search-console
plugins.description: Reads your own Search Console: the queries and pages that bring clicks, the ones close to page one, what moved since last month, and the site's true totals. Free.

plugins.name: untapped-site-audit
plugins.description: A guided live-site audit (indexed, seen, buyer phrases, on-page targeting, visitors, buyers) plus free on-page checks across a sitemap: titles, H1s, canonicals, noindex, schema, thin pages, duplicates.
